title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: governance policies check outgoing emails before they are sent
summary: The briefing's controls, opt-in default, metered prompt generation and roadmap details are supported by Microsoft's documentation. It correctly identifies conflicting documentation about overriding blocks. Some checklist steps concern controls not represented in the controls table.

claims.claim: Governance is enabled in Copilot Service admin center through Customer Support > Quality management > Governance > Manage > Governance.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, in Customer Support > select Quality management. On the Quality management page, select Manage for Governance. On the Governance page, turn on the toggle for governance.

claims.claim: PATCH /msdyn_governanceagent_statuses(msdyn_governanceagent_statusid) updates governance status, with msdyn_isenabled indicating whether the governance agent is enabled.
claims.quote: Update Event: True | PATCH /msdyn_governanceagent_statuses(msdyn_governanceagent_statusid) ... msdyn_isenabled ... column indicating whether governance agent is enabled or not

claims.claim: The policy UI is Copilot Service workspace > Service > Governance > New policy > Add a policy > Content to check > How strictly to enforce.
claims.quote: In Copilot Service workspace, go to Service > Governance. ... Select New policy ... on the Add a policy dialog ... In the Content to check section ... How strictly to enforce

claims.claim: POST /msdyn_guardrail_rules creates a governance policy record rather than configuring its enforcement settings.
claims.quote: Create Event: True | POST /msdyn_guardrail_rules

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Governance checks outbound emails drafted by representatives or AI agents against active policies before sending.
claims.quote: The system checks each email drafted by a service representative or an AI agent against active policies.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Flag noncompliant content records violations without displaying a warning.
claims.quote: Flag noncompliant content: Silently records policy violations for auditing purposes. No warning is displayed.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Warn noncompliant content displays a warning but allows the sender to proceed.
claims.quote: Warn noncompliant content: Displays a warning when policy violations are detected, but allows the email to be sent.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The use page says Block prevents sending until violations are resolved, subject to the conflicting override documentation identified in Open questions.
claims.quote: Block noncompliant content: Prevents the email from being sent until the policy violations are resolved.

claims.claim: Governance is a capability within Quality management.
claims.quote: Governance is a capability within Quality management

claims.claim: Quality Evaluation Agent powers governance.
claims.quote: Quality Evaluation Agent powers the governance capabilities.

claims.claim: The Written by setting selects Customer service representatives or Autonomous AI.
claims.quote: Written by: Select Customer service representatives or Autonomous AI.

claims.claim: Evaluating attachments in addition to the email body is optional.
claims.quote: Attached files: Select the checkbox if you want to evaluate file attachments in addition to the email body.

claims.claim: Supported attachment formats are .docx, .pdf and .txt.
claims.quote: Supported file formats are .docx, .pdf, and .txt.

claims.claim: Attachment evaluation checks text only, not image content.
claims.quote: The system evaluates only text-based content; it ignores image content in attachments.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Policy strictness offers Low, Medium, High and Very High.
claims.quote: In the Policy strictness section, select from the following options: Low ... Medium ... High ... Very High

claims.claim: Medium is the default policy strictness.
claims.quote: Medium: Default setting. Applies a balanced level of enforcement.

claims.claim: Default system policies include Email Template Adherence, Groundedness and Profanity.
claims.quote: Select New policy or select any of the default system policies, such as Email Template Adherence, Groundedness, or Profanity.

claims.claim: A simulation using organization records can select up to 30 email records.
claims.quote: If you select Organization Records, add the conditions to select the email records to test. You can select up to 30 email records.

claims.claim: Simulations can use an Excel upload.
claims.quote: If you select Excel Upload, upload your file following the Excel file requirements.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Detection logs can be reviewed on the Governance page's Policy flags/blocks log tab.
claims.quote: View logs on the Policy flags/blocks log tab on the Governance page.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the feature should not be used to make employment decisions.
claims.quote: It isn't intended to be used, and shouldn't be used, to make decisions that affect the employment of an employee or group of employees, including compensation, rewards, seniority, or other rights or entitlements.

claims.claim: Customers must notify users that their communications with representatives might be monitored.
claims.quote: customers must adequately notify users that their communications with customer service representatives (service representatives or representatives) might be monitored, recorded, or stored.

claims.claim: Customers must obtain users' consent before using the feature where applicable law requires it.
claims.quote: As required by applicable laws, customers must also obtain consent from users before they use this feature with them.

claims.claim: Microsoft encourages a mechanism to inform service representatives that their communications may be monitored.
claims.quote: customers are encouraged to have a mechanism in place to inform their service representatives that their communications with users might be monitored, recorded, or stored.

claims.quote: Provide consent for potential data movement across regions.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators require the CSR Manager security role.
claims.quote: Administrators need the CSR Manager security role.

claims.claim: Service representatives require the Customer Service Representative role.
claims.quote: Service representatives need the Customer Service Representative security role.

claims.claim: Custom administrator roles require Read, Create, Write, Delete, Append, Appendto and Assign at Global access level on the six listed governance tables.
claims.quote: For custom roles assigned to administrators, grant the Read, Create, Write, Delete, Append, Appendto, and Assign permissions at Global access level for the following tables:

claims.claim: Custom representative roles need Global Read on msdyn_governanceagent_status.
claims.quote: For custom roles assigned to service representatives, grant the Read privilege at Global access level for the msdyn_governanceagent_status table.

claims.claim: AI agents must be enabled for the Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Enable AI agents for your Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Violation reasoning and logs appear in English.
claims.quote: The violation reasoning and violation logs continue to appear in English.

claims.claim: A policy name can be configured in multiple languages.
claims.quote: You can configure a governance policy name in one or more languages so that the policy name appears in the configured language when the policy logs a violation.

claims.claim: Policy violation determination uses an LLM score rather than a deterministic content rule match.
claims.quote: Score threshold for violation determination. LLM score less than threshold equals violated, score greater than or equal to threshold equals pass.

claims.claim: Very High strictness includes minor deviations in its enforcement.
claims.quote: Very High: Applies the most aggressive enforcement, including minor deviations from policy definitions.

claims.claim: Replacing the default Send button with a custom command bypasses automatic built-in governance validation.
claims.quote: If you replace the default Send button with a custom command, the built-in governance validation doesn't run automatically before an email is sent.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Custom Send code must call validateForSend before sending to integrate governance validation.
claims.quote: Always call validateForSend from your custom command before sending the email.

claims.claim: Custom Customer Service workspace apps may require manually adding Governance to the site map through Power Apps.
claims.quote: When you're using a customized Customer Service workspace app, the Governance option might not appear in the site map. You need to manually add the Governance entry to the site map by using the Power Apps designer.

claims.claim: Policy conditions can restrict evaluation to a subset of emails.
claims.quote: Conditions for content: Add conditions to select a subset of emails that meet the conditions.

claims.claim: With no conditions selected, all emails in the check are evaluated.
claims.quote: If you don’t select any conditions, the system evaluates all emails in the check.

claims.claim: Selected Dynamics 365 Copilot and agent capabilities use consumption-based billing.
claims.quote: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 use consumption-based billing, charging per use.

claims.claim: Those Dynamics 365 capabilities use Copilot Credits for AI interactions and tasks.
claims.quote: These capabilities use Copilot Credits for AI interactions and tasks, like retrieving information and responding to prompts.

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 supports prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go, which can both be used on an environment.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 supports two billing models: prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go. ... Both billing models can be used on the Dynamics 365 environment.

claims.claim: Prepaid capacity is consumed before pay-as-you-go.
claims.quote: Prepaid capacity is consumed first.

claims.claim: The policy's generated prompt is reviewed and its instructions can be refined.
claims.quote: You must review the generated prompt. To refine the policy behavior, update the prompt instructions.

claims.claim: Administrators can review detection logs, identify repeated patterns and adjust policy descriptions to refine prompts.
claims.quote: Review detection logs. Identify repeated risk patterns. Adjust policy descriptions to refine system prompts.

claims.quote: msdyn_name ... Description | name of record ... LogicalName | msdyn_name

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly map the policy UI enforcement level or strictness to a table column.
claims.quote: Searched: "governance" "msdyn_isenabled" toggle strictness enforcement decisionthreshold. Read rule and rule-version references and Use governance policies. Decision Threshold documents LLM scoring, but none explicitly maps the UI strictness levels or enforcement choices to a column.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly state that the governance UI toggle writes msdyn_isenabled.
claims.quote: Searched: "governance" "msdyn_isenabled" toggle strictness enforcement decisionthreshold. Read Configure governance policies and msdyn_governanceagent_status reference; the enablement column is described, but no explicit UI-to-column mapping is given.

claims.claim: The Quality Management overview limits governance to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
claims.quote: Governance, which helps enforce compliance policies for outgoing customer communications. ... This feature applies only to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.

claims.claim: Learn says governance policies support the email channel.
claims.quote: Governance policies support the email channel

claims.claim: The custom Send documentation says users can override a block and the override is recorded, unlike the use page's description of Block.
claims.quote: Block the email and display a dialog that explains which policies are violated. The user can override the restriction and send the email, or cancel. The override is recorded.

claims.claim: Several checklist instructions concern controls not represented by either controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: role privileges, credits setup, cross-region consent, AI agents, simulation, custom Send validation, logs and consumption. Table: Whether governance is turned on for the environment; Creation of governance policy records.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist instructions to take stock of role privileges, check credits setup, provide cross-region consent, enable AI agents, run simulations, check custom Send integration, review logs and monitor credits where no corresponding table row exists. Retain their sourced explanatory prose; do not add control rows as part of this correction.
